card.title: T-34-85 1945
card.text: Cannot be Suppressed or lose Shock.
card.flavorText: The T-34-85 1945 was an upgraded version of the Soviet T-34-85 1944 and became the most produced variant of the T-34-85. The 1945 variant featured several key upgrades to enhance its combat effectiveness. It was equipped with an electrically powered turret traverse motor, allowing for faster and more precise turret rotation compared to manual systems, as well as a larger cupola with a one-piece hatch. Additionally, the T-34-85 1945 included the TDP smoke system, which used electrically detonated MDSh canisters to deploy smoke for battlefield concealment, helping the tank maneuver under cover and avoid enemy fire. These improvements made the T-34-85 more efficient and survivable in combat.
